verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents its own official SDK for embedding and customizing the builder in a SaaS app, plus a TypeScript framework for building pieces, and it keeps an SDK changelog. Evidence of SDK depth is thin, and nothing shows official client SDKs for the REST API. missing for 10: documented official API client SDKs across languages, detailed SDK reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
